_doc: Style bible values. Colours are sRGB hex; the engine converts to linear. Palette = the game's UI (src/client/ui/styles.css --ap-*) + rarity colours from data/game.json.

pixelSpacing._doc: Fusion Pixel spacing (design px): a space touching a CJK character is a hair space; '·' is a dotPx square on the CJK body centre line with dotGapPx either side. bodyRef: the glyph whose ink defines the CJK body (cursor height, dot line).

type._narrator: the narrator's lines (hook, pocket, tagline) at x6 (72 px) with English at 36 px

overPicture._doc: copy over a lit picture plate (world, title key art): one-art-pixel ink outline on the pixel face, soft ink shadow under the mono

multiply._doc: Plate 'multiply' layout (px). The grids themselves are in data/cast.json multiply.grids.

rarity._doc: Plate 'rarity'. Arrays are per tier order (N R SR SSR UR MYTHIC). Gold is light only: an additive core under the sprite and thin beams; the field stays navy.

battle._doc: Plate 'battle'. left/right: [x, groundY, scale] of each partner; burst: impact squares (px in art px at the target's scale), life in s.

rim._doc: inside-edge rim: one art pixel on the silhouette's side toward the light (dx, dy), at amount

ground._doc: contact on the dark backdrop: a faint warm pool + a dark core ellipse under each sprite (sizes at scale 4)

title._doc: Plate 'title'. The point bursts at the key art's sun (keyArt.pivot = the pocket point); its light warms from goldHi into the sunset (logoGlow) over coolSec and the art blooms out of it. keyArt: the game's title-screen art (game/ui/title.png, AI-generated key art, see THIRD_PARTY.md), crop = [x0, y0, w, h] in art px of the 16:9 window (scale 1.2563, sun centroid (764.2, 431.1) on the pivot), push [from, to] about the pivot, radial reveal and over-exposure, the sky behind the logo and the bottom behind the type darkened toward ink (ellipse [cx, cy, rx, ry] px), vignette to ink. shine: additive glint clipped to the logo alpha, artPx = the logo's own pixel size.

cursor._doc: the gold cursor's linear intensity: 1.0 shows goldHi itself (below the bloom threshold, so it never blows to white)

label._doc: name card under a creature (dex mono baseline at y): name em top at y+nameDy, maker baseline metaDy under the name's em box

halo._doc: light behind a subject on the navy field (Backdrop): I/r = the subject's own hue (capped so the field keeps B > R), haloI/haloR = the navy-blue falloff (palette.halo)

platePost._doc: per-plate post (merged over post); scenes only add event overrides (flash, shake)

grade._doc: in-scene grade of picture plates (3D diorama, painted backdrop) before type is composited: exposure (linear gain), saturation, contrast (log, pivot 0.18), tint (linear multiply). world/together/catch are golden hour (warm, saturation 1.1).

catch._doc: Plate 'catch' (px). tufts/rowDy/rowTint: [front, back] grass rows (rowTint linear rgb: the golden-hour light on the game's tufts); tuftJitterArtPx: each tuft sunk 0..n art px; hover = where the ball hangs while it fills; throwFrom = off-screen start of the throw; ballGroundDy: the resting ball's centre below the creature's ground line (its bottom sits just in front of the front grass row, on its contact shadow); darkTint: extra linear-rgb multiplier on the dark tufts (the game sprite is cool grey-violet; warmed to dusky olive)

pocket._doc: Plate 'pocket': the gold point keeps its light inside coreR; the halo (palette.halo) carries the falloff

castArc._doc: reveal plate, last bar: the nine heroines (data/cast.json heroines) in an arc; slot k pops at ceil(i/2)*popBeats after cue cast; outer slots stand higher (further back): ground = groundY - risePx*(|k|/4)^risePow
